name: speed
title: player.speed
lead: The body: what a pack sets on a player. See docs/luau-api.md, "Body and movement". Walk speed as a multiple of normal; 0 pins them.

usedIn.quote: player.speed = 2           -- walk speed as a multiple of normal; 0 pins them, 1 is normal
`player.speed = 0` for a cutscene. Do not use `gamemode = 3`.
}, { easing = "in_out", on_done = function() player.camera = nil player.speed = 1 end })
